input.quote: e. Access. Client will have access to Interface usage statistics and raw log files in real time via the Interface.
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right exercisable against Client, and no TrueLink access to Client systems; the only access and documentation rights run in our favour (Sections 3(e) and 6). Better than our preferred position, so no redline.

input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or termination-related minimum payment is imposed on Client; Client's only exposure is the monthly minimum fees while services are being provided, which is a commercial floor rather than a penalty (addressed under MINCOMMIT). Nothing to redline under this rule.

input.quote: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT, TRUELINK DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL EXPENSES WARRANTIES, WARRANTIES OF FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FOR ANY MATTER RELATING TO THE ACCURACY OR COMPLETENESS, OR TIMING OF TRANSMISSION OF ANY DATA SUBMITTED THROUGH THE INTERFACE OR TO OR FROM THE WEB SITE.
input.rationale: The only express TrueLink warranty is Y2K-specific (Section 9); there is no conformance-to-documentation warranty, no workmanlike-performance standard (Section 11's "same care as for its own operations" is not an industry standard) and no remedy, while the disclaimer strips everything else. That falls below the fallback, so we inserted the 90-day conformance and workmanlike warranties with a re-perform/repair/refund remedy, carved out of the disclaimer.

input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no insurance obligation at all, which is unacceptable for a vendor hosting our web site and processing borrower credit data. We inserted a short insurance section (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, certificates on request) after Section 30.
